usageNotes: Use this to inspect the current configuration and health of a named Ceph pool on a specific cluster node; the queried node must be online and running Ceph services. Pass verbose=true to include live usage and I/O statistics in the response — omitting it returns configuration fields only. Requires either Sys.Audit or Datastore.Audit at the root path.

examples.summary: Get full status with statistics for the 'vm-storage' pool

tips: The 'statistics' object in the response is only present when verbose=1 is requested; omitting verbose saves response size when you only need pool configuration.
Check 'nodelete', 'nopgchange', and 'nosizechange' flags before attempting pool modification operations — they indicate Ceph-level locks that will cause write operations to fail.
The 'autoscale_status' object shape varies across Ceph releases; treat it as opaque unless you know the exact cluster version.
Any cluster node running Ceph MON can serve this request; you do not need to query the node that owns the pool's primary OSDs.
